Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2023 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of CVX.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1042 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 17% to 15% next quarter, subject to market conditions.

We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 174 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.

Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
